message.content: {"summary":"You established a well-motivated mission concept tailored to the Australian context and included a clear schedule breakdown. However, the submission lacks technical engineering progress and specific operational requirements.","next_steps":["Define quantified mission and payload requirements, such as spatial resolution, revisit rates, and spectral bands for coral monitoring.","Generate preliminary engineering results in STK or MATLAB, such as orbit selection and coverage analysis, to show technical feasibility.","Upgrade references from raw URLs to a complete, formal referencing style (e.g., IEEE) and add formal captions to all figures."],"criteria":{"C1":"You effectively identified end users and articulated a strong rationale in 'Mission Concept & Rationale'. To reach Accomplished, define specific, quantified mission goals, functional requirements, and preliminary payload or operational specifications rather than high-level statements.","C2":"Your Gantt chart (Image 1) and task breakdown in 'Project Plan & Preliminary Progress' lay out a feasible schedule. To achieve an Accomplished level, incorporate explicit contingency planning, schedule variation management, and a risk analysis framework tailored to your mission.","C3":"Completing STK tutorials shows familiarisation, but you provided no actual preliminary engineering data. To reach Adequate or Accomplished, include initial technical work such as trade studies, orbit propagation analyses, or baseline link/mass budget calculations with brief interpretations.","C4":"Your report is logically structured and easy to read. To reach Accomplished, ensure all graphics (such as Image 1) include proper figure numbers and captions, and format entries in 'Useful Links' into a consistent, formal bibliographic citation style."}}
